pending.title: Your account is waiting for access
pending.subtitle: Sign-in worked, but you are not a member of any workspace yet.
pending.text: Ask an administrator to add you to a workspace. Once they have, sign out and sign in again.
pending.first_text: You are the first person to sign in to this install, and its first workspace still belongs to the placeholder owner the setup wizard created. Run this in a terminal where OCTOPUS_API_KEY holds the key the wizard printed, then sign in again:
pending.first_workspace_hint: The command reads the workspace id from $OCTOPUS_OPERATOR_WORKSPACE. Export it first: its value is OCTOPUS_OPERATOR_WORKSPACE in deploy/.env (Docker) or in extraEnv in the Helm values (Kubernetes).

notices.first_user: The first person to sign in becomes the workspace owner.
notices.dev_link: This install has no logins. Open the dashboard with the link the daemon prints on start, or run {cmd} on the machine it runs on.
notices.no_provider: No identity provider is configured, so there is no way to sign in yet. Set {issuer}, {client_id} and {client_secret} on the daemon and restart it.

errors.config_rejected: The daemon rejected the configuration request. Check its logs.

reasons.state_expired: The sign-in took too long. Try again.
reasons.session_missing: The sign-in started in another browser or tab, or took too long. Start it again here.
reasons.email_unverified: Verify your email in {provider}, then sign in again.
reasons.email_unverified_generic: Verify your email with your identity provider, then sign in again.

invite.for: You were invited to {workspace}. Sign in with {email}.
invite.awaiting: That email doesn't have access yet. After you sign in you can ask for it.
invite.gone: This invitation was already used or canceled. Sign in to see where you have access.
invite.full: {workspace} has no places left right now. Ask an admin there to free one or upgrade the plan; your invitation stays saved and goes through the next time you sign in.

not_invited.title: You don't have access yet
not_invited.text: {email} is not on the access list yet.
not_invited.invited: {workspaces} invited you. Access comes from whoever runs Thulu, and the invitation waits until then.
not_invited.invited_many: {workspaces} invited you. Access comes from whoever runs Thulu, and the invitations wait until then.
not_invited.request_hint: Request access tells whoever runs this install. Once they let you in, sign in with this same email.
not_invited.waitlist_hint: If nobody on this install knows you:
not_invited.requested: Request sent. Once you have access, sign in again with {email}.
